summary: The foreign private issuer filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing the launch of an AI-enabled Orthorectification Service on the UP42 platform. This is a routine product or service announcement, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC event, or management change is described. The registrant is simply reporting a new service offering.
